confirmed_improvements: All six cases independently pass deterministic fidelity validation.
The complete ref anchors fig:result and fig:trend are preserved.
All source numbers, formulas, citation keys, and protected terms are preserved.
No case adds or removes a number and all declared_derived_values are empty.
shallow_result states both result relevance and the mechanism evidence gap without inventing a cause.
Necessary scope, causal limitation, and negative evidence remain present.

remaining_risks: Substring semantic assertions can false-pass negation or irony.
A fixed phrase vocabulary can false-fail valid paraphrases outside the fixture vocabulary.
Multiset fidelity cannot prove that every number remains bound to the same object and claim.
The general validator compares citation keys and reference labels but does not fully preserve every command type and option.
Term presence alone cannot prove correct semantic use.

limitations: This admission covers six synthetic Writing cases only.
It does not validate a real full paper, cross-section consistency, figure truth, citation truth, or submission quality.
